basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast and casual gamer from Minneapolis, Minnesota. I work as a software developer during the day, and in my free time, I enjoy exploring new tech gadgets and gaming on my Hisense TV. I'm in a committed relationship and often spend evenings with my partner unwinding with some Arrowverse shows or listening to 93x. I dislike social media interruptions during personal time, which might explain my active participation in discussions around relationship dynamics. I usually browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late at night after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Minnesota. My tech knowledge is bolstered by years of self-teaching and staying updated with the latest in software development and consumer electronics. I also follow the entertainment industry closely, given my interest in TV shows and gaming.
